title: Basic
description: Grouped pages and actions, filtered as you type. ⌘K or Ctrl+K opens it anywhere on the page; the trigger shows the keys. Typed words are marked in the labels. Choosing a link item follows it and any item reports select; with recent (off by default, kept in localStorage) recent choices come first next time.

title: Server search
description: Results come from the server as you type. Livewire fetches them from an endpoint (url) that returns JSON; React and Vue fetch them from search-change and pass them back with remote and loading.
